content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Television channels and streaming services with subscriptions and scripted programming; not an ad-supported digital publishing business."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Physical outdoor billboards and transit displays; no owned digital content brands or affiliate commerce."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Ad verification and measurement software for advertisers; does not own consumer content brands."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Mainly news subscriptions, books and property listing portals; different core products from lifestyle and commerce publishing."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Agency services creating campaigns for brands; does not own consumer media titles or sell its own audience."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Marketing and public relations agency fees for corporate clients; a service provider rather than a brand owner."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Native ad recommendation software placed on publisher sites; technology platform rather than owned consumer media brands."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Owns lifestyle, finance and sports websites and magazines, earning ads, sponsored content and affiliate commissions."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Radio stations and cable television for a niche audience; broadcast licences and airtime sales differ from digital publishing."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Home goods retailer selling products through stores and websites; earns from merchandise sales, not advertising or content."},{"label":"C11","good":true,"reason":"Owns health and consumer digital media brands earning ads and affiliate commissions, though it also sells software."}]}
